# Toward Zenith

> > A hard science fiction worldbuilding project exploring 350+ years of FTL exploration, exotic matter physics, and humanity's expansion across 6000+ star systems.

Toward Zenith is a comprehensive sci-fi universe set in year 352 FA (First Arrival), featuring logically consistent technologies like warp drives, particle accelerators, and neural interfaces. The project emphasizes realistic physics, alien biochemistry, and the sociopolitical challenges of interstellar civilization spanning from the Interior core worlds to the Periphery frontier.

## Key Topics

- FTL/Warp Drive Technology
- Exotic Matter & Particle Physics
- Subspace Physics
- Interstellar Civilization (6000+ systems)
- Interior vs Periphery Regions
- Alien Biochemistry
- Neural Interface Technology
- Uninet (Universal Network)
- Pre-Warp History
- Energy Weapons & Defense Systems
- Material Science & Magnetic Containment
- Year 352 FA Timeline
- Worldbuilding Methodology

## Society & Civilization

- [Society](https://towardzenith.com/society): Year 352 FA: humanity's spread across star systems via warp drive
- [Civilization](https://towardzenith.com/society/civilization): Human civilization spanning 6000+ star systems from Interior to Periphery
- [History](https://towardzenith.com/society/history): Humanity's origin on Home planet and sub-light colonization history
- [Pre-Warp History](https://towardzenith.com/society/history/pre-warp-history): Early space exploration timeline before FTL: Moon bases and FSA missions
- [Nations and Societies](https://towardzenith.com/galactography/nations-and-societies): Interstellar nations, power consolidation challenges, cultural evolution
- [Uninet](https://towardzenith.com/society/uninet): Universal Network: civilization-wide communication and information exchange

## Science & Physics

- [Science](https://towardzenith.com/science): Natural universe research across overlapping fields and subdivisions
- [Physics](https://towardzenith.com/science/physics): Fundamental universe study: matter, energy, spacetime, gravity, subspace
- [Chemistry](https://towardzenith.com/science/chemistry): Study of matter, particle physics, and material science in civilization
- [Material Science](https://towardzenith.com/science/chemistry/material-science): Material science applications: magnetic containment and particle bonding
- [Astronomy](https://towardzenith.com/science/astronomy): Celestial objects study: planets, stars, nebulae, galaxies, universe
- [Biology](https://towardzenith.com/science/biology): Life study: human biotechnology and alien organic chemistry biospheres
- [Alien Biochemistry](https://towardzenith.com/science/biology/alien-biochemistry): Diverse alien life chemistry: carbon-based organisms and homeworld elements

## Technology & Engineering

- [Technology](https://towardzenith.com/technology): Applied science and innovation for space exploration and survival
- [Transportation](https://towardzenith.com/technology/transportation): Transportation technologies and systems across space civilization

- [Biotechnology](https://towardzenith.com/technology/social/biotechnology): Human biotechnologies for space adaptation including neural interfaces

## Military Technology

- [Military](https://towardzenith.com/technology/military): Energy weapons using energized matter and electronification shielding
